newsitem.title: USA: Tosco Q1 shr diluted $0.03 vs $0.21.
newsitem.headline: Tosco Q1 shr diluted $0.03 vs $0.21.

text.p: (Thousands of Dollars, Except Per Share Data)

(1) Tosco completed its acquisition of The Circle K Corporation on May 30, 1996. Circle K has approximately 2,500 convenience stores, of which approximately 2,300 are company- controlled and approximately 1,900 sell gasoline.
Additionally, Tosco purchased British Petroleum's Northeast refining and marketing assets on February 2, 1996.
(2) The increase in sales is attributable to the acquisition of Circle K net of reduced refinery production and lower petroleum sales prices.

(3) Operating contribution increased due to the impact of the Circle K acquisition net of reduced refinery operating contribution. Refinery operating contribution decreased due to a number of factors, including the unscheduled shutdown of the Bayway Refinery's cat cracker; the scheduled turnaround at the Avon Refinery's coker unit; the shutdown of the Avon Refinery's hydrocracker as a result of a fire in January 1997; unusually mild winter weather on the East Coast in 1997; and high raw material prices which could not be fully recovered in the markets.

Refinery operating margins include $53 million (net of eductible amounts and asset write-offs) of insurance recoveries for damages and business interruption claims at the Avon hydrocracker and the Bayway cat cracker.
(4) The increase in SG&A expenses for 1997 is attributable to the acquisition of Circle K.
(5) Net interest expense increased due to higher debt levels incurred to finance Tosco's expanded operations and acquisitions.
(6) Tosco's effective income tax rate for 1997 increased due to its acquisitions.
(7) During December 1996, Tosco Financing Trust (a Delaware business trust, all of whose common securities are owned by Tosco) issued 6,000,000 shares of 5.75% Trust Preferred Securities.
The sole assets of Tosco Financing Trust are 5.75% convertible junior subordinated debentures of Tosco.

(8) The earnings per share amounts reflect the 3-for-1 stock split declared and distributed in February 1997. On March 31, 1997, Tosco paid a quarterly dividend of $.06 per common share to shareholders of record on March 21, 1997.
